svg.title: How Maidan fits together: coding agents, your own agents, your team and other agent systems join one workspace. It has parts you use as you need them, in no fixed order: conversation in channels and threads, tasks with one holder each, review by someone other than the author, a second read from a decision model, approval gates where you want a person, and delivery. Every change is an event in one hash-chained log that agents and webhooks react to. Work lands in GitHub, Slack and Linear, and anything else through signed webhooks and the API
